findings.finding: The 9M result will include the >EUR54m Bending Spoons IPO gain realised on 1 July, so 9M pro forma profit will print far above 9M25's EUR65.9m. The company told the market this in the H1 release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Day after the 9M25 release (+50% headline profit): +1.93% (17 Nov 2025). Day after 9M24: -2.27%. Day after the H1 26 release: -8.58%
findings.original_quote: Dato che la quotazione in borsa di Bending Spoons è stata l’1 luglio, tali risultati non includono la plusvalenza, di oltre 54 milioni, realizzata immediatamente dopo la chiusura del periodo.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the gain was pre-announced and BSP is quoted daily. A holding trades on NAV and discount, not on pro forma profit, so a mechanical headline beat should move nothing. Filed because it is the release's largest line, sized near 0
findings.independence: The 9M25 precedent: a headline +50% profit drew a +1.93% reaction (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2025/11/14/ref-213.html)

findings.finding: TIP is buying back steadily, at 13.273% of capital in treasury on 16 Oct, with purchases accelerating in October. This is a known bid under the stock through the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback has run all year; it did not stop the -8.6% after H1

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is disclosed weekly. The only unpriced part is the flow itself on the window's sessions. If it were fully priced, TIP would not have held ~EUR9.1 while BSP fell 16% from 28 Oct to 12 Nov
